第70章 你自己开家店单干多好-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

林国强笑了。

那种笑，李红霞看着有点发毛。

“妈，我问你几个事。”

“你问。”

“大哥懂卤味吗？老三懂火候吗？”

李红霞一愣。

“我的配方，是我精心琢磨出来的。”

林国强看着她，“他们来了，配方教不教？教了，他们学会了，自己出去开店，跟我打擂台。

不教，他们能干啥？烧火？切菜？

这种活儿我随便请个人都能干，一个月二十块钱工资，凭啥要分股份给他们？”

李红霞张了张嘴。

“再说采买，老三连自家日子都过不明白，能买好肉？能挑好料？买到次品怎么办？亏了本算谁的？”

李红霞急了：“他们都是你亲兄弟！”

“亲兄弟？”林国强看着她，“分家的时候，我的木料给大哥盖了砖瓦房，我的退伍安置费给老三买了自行车缝纫机。

他们当初拿我的东西的时候，可没想着还，后面我去要账的时候，大哥老三那话说得有多难听，妈你不是没听见，那时候他们怎么没想起我是亲兄弟？”

“坑我的时候，他们可一点没手软。”

李红霞脸色涨红：“那都是过去的事了……”

“在我这儿，没过去。”

林国强打断她，“妈，今天我把话说明白。

我这生意，是我踏踏实实干出来的。

配方是我的，客源是我的，渠道是我的。

谁要是想进来分一杯羹，拿真金白银来入股。

五百块，一成股。

大哥老三拿得出，我欢迎，拿不出，免谈。”

“五百块？”李红霞腾地站起来，“你抢钱呢？”

“嫌贵可以不入股。”

林国强重新拿起筷子，从锅里捞卤味，“我又没求着他们来。”

“你……”

“妈，你要是来看我的，我欢迎。

要是来替你大儿子小儿子要好处的，趁早回去。

我这店里忙，没工夫陪你唠。”

李红霞气得浑身发抖，指着林国强：“国强，你现在有钱了，眼里就没有爹妈兄弟了是吧？”

林国强放下筷子，转过身看着她。

“妈，你这话说反了。”

Chapter 70 How good would it be if you opened your own shop and worked alone - "Rebirth in 80s, after separation, you will take your wife and daughter to have a good time"

Lin Guoqiang smiled.

That kind of smile made Li Hongxia feel a little hairy.

"Mom, let me ask you a few things."

"You asked."

"Does the eldest brother know braised food? Does the third brother know how to cook?"

Li Hongxia was stunned.

"My formula is carefully thought out by me."

Lin Guoqiang looked at her, "They are here, are they taught the formula? Yes, they have learned it, they will go out to open their own shop and compete with me in the ring.

If they don’t teach, what can they do?Make a fire?Cutting vegetables?

I can hire anyone to do this kind of work, and the salary is twenty yuan a month, so why should I give them shares?"

Li Hongxia opened her mouth.

"Let's talk about purchasing. The third child doesn't even know how to live his own life. Can he buy good meat? Can he choose good ingredients? What should I do if I buy a defective product? Whose responsibility is it for the loss?"

Li Hongxia was anxious: "They are all your brothers!"

"Brother?" Lin Guoqiang looked at her, "When we separated, I used the lumber to build a brick house for my eldest brother, and I bought a bicycle and sewing machine for my third brother with my discharge settlement funds.

When they took my things, they didn't think of paying them back. When I went to ask for the account later, what the eldest brother and the third brother said were so unpleasant. Mom, didn't you hear it? Why didn't they remember that I was a biological brother at that time?"

"They showed no mercy when they tried to trick me."

Li Hongxia's face turned red: "That's all in the past..."

"I'm here, I haven't gone there."

Lin Guoqiang interrupted her, "Mom, let me make it clear today.

My business was built by my hard work.

The formula is mine, the customers are mine, and the channels are mine.

If anyone wants to come in and get a piece of the pie, use real money to invest in it.

Five hundred yuan, one share.

If the eldest brother and the third brother can take it, I welcome it. If they can’t, let’s not talk about it."

"Five hundred yuan?" Li Hongxia stood up, "Are you trying to steal the money?"

“You don’t have to invest in it if it’s too expensive.”

Lin Guoqiang picked up the chopsticks again and fished out the braised meat from the pot, "I didn't ask them to come."

"You..."

"Mom, if you come to see me, I welcome you.

If you are here to seek benefits for your eldest and younger son, go back as soon as possible.

I'm busy in the store and don't have time to chat with you."

Li Hongxia was so angry that she was shaking all over and pointed at Lin Guoqiang: "Guoqiang, now that you are rich, you no longer have the eyes of your parents and brothers, right?"

Lin Guoqiang put down his chopsticks and turned around to look at her.

"Mom, what you said is contrary to what I said."
